Doctors at a hospital in Pune have advised open-heart surgery within the next two months. The surgery, hospital stay and medicines cost ₹3,00,000, which the family cannot pay.
Ananya gets breathless after a few steps and has stopped going to school. Her mother says she cries at night because she is scared and in pain. The family has already sold their gold and borrowed from relatives, and they are losing hope.
Every contribution, however small, goes directly to the hospital.
